DAA.undefined_OF.description: OF equals 8-bit ADD overflow for old AL + d, where d = (low-nibble > 9 or input AF ? 6 : 0) + (old AL > 0x99 or input CF ? 0x60 : 0)

DAS.undefined_OF.description: OF equals 8-bit SUB overflow for old AL - d, with the same d condition as DAA

AAA.undefined_OSZP.description: OF, SF, ZF and PF equal flags of 16-bit AX + d BEFORE AL is masked to four bits; d = 0x106 when adjustment is selected, otherwise zero

AAS.undefined_OSZP.description: OF, SF, ZF and PF equal flags of 16-bit AX - d BEFORE AL is masked to four bits; d = 0x106 when adjustment is selected, otherwise zero

AAM.undefined_OAC.description: On successful AAM, OF = AF = CF = 0

AAD.undefined_OAC.description: OF, AF and CF equal flags of an 8-bit ADD of old AL and ((old AH * immediate) & 0xff)

AAM.zero_trap.description: AAM immediate zero traps and preserves input AX and all six arithmetic flags in the saved fault context

SALC.observed.description: SALC gives AL = input CF ? 0xff : 0, preserving all six arithmetic flags

PUSHSEG32.upper.description: 32-bit segment PUSH zeroes the upper 16 bits of its four-byte stack slot, overwriting the initial 0xa5a5 high half

STACK.flags.description: PUSHA/PUSHAD/POPA/POPAD preserve all six arithmetic flags

SEGMENT.flags.description: PUSH/POP of measured segment registers preserve all six arithmetic flags

INCDEC.CF.description: All measured INC/DEC register forms preserve CF

BOUND.flags.description: BOUND preserves all six arithmetic flags, including saved out-of-range fault contexts

INTO.flags.description: INTO preserves all six arithmetic flags, including saved overflow trap contexts

ARPL.preserved.description: ARPL preserves CF, PF, AF, SF and OF (ZF alone is the architecturally modified arithmetic flag)

LAHF.flags.description: LAHF preserves all six arithmetic flags

SHL.undefined_AF.description: SHL in compatibility mode: count zero preserves AF; every nonzero masked count sets AF

SHL.undefined_OF.description: SHL in compatibility mode, masked count > 1: OF equals sign(final result) XOR output CF
